# `greatest`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
greatest(expr, ...)
```

Returns the greatest value of all parameters, skipping null values.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- greatest, example 1
> SELECT greatest(10, 9, 2, 4, 3);
10
```
